text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*...! I couldn't get first 
place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, I ran all the way to 
the end! Pretty amazing, right?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! But you know, I'm not that tired 
at all! Because it was so, so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like running more and more! Now 
that I've debuted, I can run a whole 
bunch, right?"

To build up ability, just entering races 
and gaining experience might be a good 
goal to aim for.

As she continues to run there, she'll 
likely find the races she truly wants to 
run herself.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hm? Huh-huh-huh!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look, over there! Everyone from the 
shopping district is here!

Looking in Haru Urara's direction, all the 
folks from the shopping district she's 
close with had gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: Urara-chaaan! Everyone, on three!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text: Congrats on your debut~!
(Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waah~! It's a banner!

What the people from the shopping district 
held up was a banner that read: 
"Congratulations on your debut, 
Urara-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Urara-chan run at the racetrack 
totally touched my heart!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text: I'll keep cheering you on from now on too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yup, thanks! I'm gonna run a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Do your best!

"...She's only just made her debut, yet it 
feels like a full-blown festival. The 
folks in the shopping district really do 
adore Haru Urara."

"Then I must live up to those 
expectations. Once more, I swore to make 
Haru Urara strong!"
